text: During the Gathering, Yewstar cozies up to the CougarClan leader in an attempt to get in CougarClan's good graces. They don't seem very receptive, though. (CougarClan relations unchanged.)
When RiverClan finds Icyriver, her fur bushes up and eyes widen at the sight of so many cats. It doesn't take much to drive her out; she turns tail and flees.
Yewstar wants to spend time with friends, but all of them have plans with Nutkit. (high negative effect)
Freezefoot is poised to help train Yewstar. (medium positive effect)
